tha-ap458:1.1: Vanakoraṇḍiya.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato lokajeṭṭhassa tādino / vanakoraṇḍam ādāya Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap458:2.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap458:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Vanakoraṇḍiyo th. i. g. a-ti.
